complexity_ledger.narrative: RP-05 closes the two stale-record defects filed against this epic's own dogfooding: CM-01-DF-01/AC-DF-01 (the one red test every prior ticket in this epic was told to ignore) and EV-01-DF-03 (a comment contradicting the measurement beside it). 1. test_skill_requires_two_minute_case_generation_budget asserted the literal phrase "hard two-minute budget" in references/generation_modes.md. The c72d03a docs refresh reworded that sentence to "hard wall-time budget: `budgets.tlc_seconds` in `spec_manifest.yaml`, default 120 seconds" -- naming the actual config key instead of a fixed literal. Restoring the old phrase would have reverted a genuine accuracy improvement (the new wording points at the real, checked-in default: spec_manifest.yaml `tlc_seconds: 120`) purely to satisfy a test. Chosen instead: retarget the assertion at the durable fact -- that the budget's config key (`budgets.tlc_seconds`) and its value (120 seconds) are documented -- rather than an exact sentence. A test asserting doc prose verbatim is a maintenance tax with no compensating signal (it does not catch the budget being undocumented, only a paraphrase); asserting the key name and value is checked whenever it changes and survives copy-editing. 2. specs/program_model/architecture_components.yaml's comment claimed the AC-02 reflexion dogfood "found edges across both" of the two unported component pairs (`tickets<->kill`, `corpus<->kill`). The actual measured result, both at AC-02's original 2026-07-27 run (references/ architecture_coherence.md) and re-measured here 2026-07-30, is DIVERGENCES (0) -- the opposite claim. The edge count also drifted: 258 at AC-02's writing vs 263 now (143 internal, 120 crossing, all 120 convergences). Re-ran `analyze architecture ... --components architecture_components.yaml --code scripts --map architecture_map.yaml` (specs/tickets/RP-05/results/architecture-reflexion.txt) to confirm both numbers directly rather than trust the filed finding. The comment now states the measured counts (263 edges, 0 divergences, 0 absences) with the run date and a pointer to re-run the check for the current figure, and deliberately does NOT restate the verdict word (`unmappable`/`coherent`/ etc.) since RP-01 is concurrently changing how that command reports its verdict -- recording the verdict wording here would create the exact same staleness defect the moment RP-01 merges. Both fixes are documentation/test-only; RP-05 carries ZERO TLA+ model delta, confirmed by comparing specs/tickets/RP-05/current against specs/tickets/RP-05/desired after a clean __pycache__ (identical) and by the complexity ledger's own delta header (direction=zero vs EV-02). Full repository suite: `uv run --with pytest --with pyyaml -m pytest tests -q` -- 865 passed, 0 failed. This is the first fully green run of this epic; every prior ticket carried CM-01-DF-01/AC-DF-01 as a known, explicitly out-of-scope red test.
